item.title: openssh{_gssapi}: 10.3p1 -> 10.4p1
item.description:
Changelog: https://www.openssh.org/txt/release-10.4

Marked for backport because there are a few non-critical security fixes and the worst breaking change seems to be sshd -G not outputting config directives in lowercase anymore.

seccomp is also now required (and will fail on kernels that don't support seccomp entirely, which is to say some < 4.x ancient history).

hpn patch is not yet updated (tried applying the patches, there are conflicts). gssapi patch is.

To staging-nixos since it rebuilds NixOS tests.
